class.name: CgameTrace
class.brief_description: Low-overhead trace capture with Chrome / Perfetto JSON export.
class.description: [CgameTrace] records scopes, counters, instant events, flow arrows and frame markers into per-thread ring buffers. Each buffer is written by exactly one thread without locks or allocations, so recording from many threads (including [WorkerThreadPool] tasks) does not serialize them. While [member enabled] is [code]false[/code] every recording call returns after a single atomic load. Scopes are stored as complete events when they end, so a ring buffer that overwrites old events can never leave an orphaned begin/end pair. [member max_events] is the per-thread capacity and applies to threads that record their first event after it was changed. Frame markers are inserted automatically once per main loop iteration while [member auto_frame_markers] is enabled. Each marker closes a per-frame aggregate (scope microseconds and last counter values) that feeds [method frame_stats], [method frames] and [CgameHitchCorrelator]. The JSON produced by [method export_chrome_json] can be opened in [code]chrome://tracing[/code] or [code]ui.perfetto.dev[/code]. From C++ use the [code]CGAME_TRACE_SCOPE(name)[/code], [code]CGAME_TRACE_COUNTER(name, value)[/code] and [code]CGAME_TRACE_INSTANT(name)[/code] macros from [code]modules/cgame_profiling/cgame_trace.h[/code]. Names passed to the macros must be string literals. [codeblock] CgameTrace.enabled = true CgameTrace.begin("ai") # ... CgameTrace.end() CgameTrace.save("user://trace.json") [/codeblock]

method.name: begin
method.description: Opens a scope on the calling thread. Scopes nest; close each one with [method end].

method.name: clear
method.description: Discards all recorded events and frame records. Thread names are kept.

method.name: compare
method.description: Compares two [method frame_stats] results and returns the scopes whose average per-frame cost grew by more than [param threshold_pct] percent, worst first, as dictionaries with the keys [code]scope[/code], [code]baseline_avg[/code], [code]current_avg[/code] and [code]pct[/code]. Scopes that are new or have a zero baseline are skipped.

method.name: counter
method.description: Records a counter sample. The last value per frame is stored in the frame record.

method.name: end
method.description: Closes the innermost open scope of the calling thread. Does nothing when no scope is open or tracing is disabled.

method.name: event_count
method.description: Returns the number of events currently held in all thread buffers.

method.name: export_chrome_json
method.description: Returns the captured events as Chrome Trace Event Format JSON, ordered chronologically with enclosing scopes before the scopes they contain.

method.name: flow_end
method.description: Ends the flow arrow started with [method flow_start] using the same [param id], typically on the consuming thread.

method.name: flow_start
method.description: Starts a flow arrow (for example a task hand-off between threads).

method.name: frame_marker
method.description: Marks a frame boundary and closes the per-frame aggregates. The first marker only establishes the baseline. Called automatically every main loop iteration when [member auto_frame_markers] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: frame_stats
method.description: Returns [code]{"frames": n, "scopes": {name: {"total", "avg", "max"}}}[/code] with all values in microseconds over the retained frame records.

method.name: frames
method.description: Returns the retained frame records as dictionaries with the keys [code]index[/code], [code]ms[/code], [code]scopes[/code] (microseconds per scope) and [code]counters[/code]. This is the input format of [method CgameHitchCorrelator.correlate].

method.name: instant
method.description: Records a point-in-time event with optional JSON-serializable [param args].

method.name: load_stats_json
method.description: Loads statistics saved with [method save_stats_json]. Returns an empty dictionary when the file is missing or malformed.

method.name: measure
method.description: Runs [param callable] inside a scope and returns its result.

method.name: save
method.description: Writes [method export_chrome_json] to [param path]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be opened.

method.name: save_stats_json
method.description: Writes [method frame_stats] as JSON to [param path]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be opened.

method.name: set_thread_name
method.description: Names the calling thread in the exported trace.

method.name: thread_count
method.description: Returns the number of threads that own a trace buffer.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the engine inserts a frame marker at the end of every main loop iteration while tracing is enabled.
Master switch. While [code]false[/code] all recording calls are no-ops.
Ring buffer capacity in events per thread (rounded up to a power of two). The oldest events are overwritten. Applies to threads that record their first event after the change.
Number of frame records kept for [method frame_stats] and [method frames].
